posts.caption_text:
?????? ????? ?? ??? ???????? ???? ??????? ? ? - A target for sometime given the lack of freight activity and loco-hauled scene on the Cambrian Line has been the Aberystwyth timber train. 
In the early hours of Saturday 2 September, the empty timber train went in to Aberystwyth as 6C54 02.15 from Coton Hill meaning the train would return in the early hours of Sunday 3 September because of the lack of train paths available. 
A five hour drive with my friend Jim through the night was required for Network Rail 97302 ‘Rheilffyrdd Ffestiniog ac Eryri/Ffestiniog & Welsh Highland Railways' leading HNRC 37405 (on hire to Colas Rail) powering the 6C55 07:20 Aberystwyth Krono Colas to Chirk Kronospan Colas Rail, loaded timber train which is shattering the early morning peace at Borth on 3 September 2023. The tractors would be replaced by 56096 at Sutton Bridge Junction.
